# Typical "protect the site from AI" configuration, copied off a blog post.
# This is exactly the pattern that makes a business uncitable without anyone
# realising it, which is why the audit weights it most heavily.

User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Disallow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: *
Disallow: /wp-admin/
Allow: /
